position_strategy: 2026 remains RB-scarce at the very top (roughly a dozen true workhorses exist, and the rookie class outside Jeanty/Judkins/Love is thin), so the consensus for pick 4 leans WR-first / Hero-RB: take the best available elite WR (Chase/Nacua tier) or a top-4 bell-cow RB if one slides, then hammer a second stud RB or WR in round 2 rather than committing to a pure Zero-RB build, since true bell-cows (Etienne, Montgomery, Tuten, Walker under Reid) dry up fast after round 4. QB should wait: with Josh Allen's ADP in the late 3rd and QB depth 15-20 deep, experts (FantasyPros, 4for4) consistently say don't draft a QB before round 6-8; the format's 4-pt passing TD (vs 6-pt rush/rec) also mutes elite passer scarcity relative to standard leagues, making rushing QBs (late Purdy, Kyler Murray, Malik Willis) efficient late fliers. TE is similarly a wait-and-stream-upside position outside the true top tier (McBride, Bowers, Warren) — target ascending role players like Tucker Kraft, Harold Fannin Jr., Kyle Pitts, Dalton Kincaid, and Isaiah Likely from round 6 on rather than reaching. Workhorse/bell-cow backs to prioritize: Jahmyr Gibbs, Bijan Robinson, Jonathan Taylor (though TD regression risk flagged), Christian McCaffrey (health risk), Saquon Barkley, Ashton Jeanty (injury-clouded), Kenneth Walker III, Travis Etienne Jr., David Montgomery, Bhayshul Tuten, Rachaad White (workload-growth path), and Tony Pollard/D'Andre Swift as later-round bell-cow value. Committee/timeshare backs to be wary of paying full ADP for: Jonathon Brooks/Chuba Hubbard, D'Andre Swift/David Montgomery banked at their own team-shares, RJ Harvey/J.K. Dobbins, and any Josh Jacobs shares given his commissioner's-exempt-list absence.
notes: Josh Jacobs (LV RB) fell roughly 60-113 ADP spots after being placed on the NFL commissioner's exempt list following a May arrest, effectively a must-avoid at his listed ADP (source: FantasyPros ADP Risers & Fallers, Aug/Sep 2026).

MarShawn Lloyd (GB RB) rose ~57 spots into the RB2/RB3 conversation as presumed lead back with Jacobs sidelined, after an explosive camp (source: FantasyPros '16 Players Trending Up & Down', Sept 2026).
DJ Moore (WR) climbed into the WR26 range after an offseason trade to Buffalo to be Josh Allen's new WR1, a major QB/situation upgrade (source: FantasyPros trending players, Sept 2026).

Malik Nabers is called both 'grossly undervalued' with WR1/No.1-overall upside by one outlet and listed among 'most overvalued WRs' by SI Onsi featuring Nabers — treated here as a modest, mixed-signal value rather than a big boost (sources: fantasysixpack Undervalued Players, Sept 2026; SI Onsi Overvalued WRs, Aug 2026).
Aaron Jones Sr. is 'badly underpriced at an RB43 cost' per analysts who say the durability discount is too generous for his talent (source: fantasysixpack Undervalued Players, Aug/Sept 2026).

Jonathan Taylor is a listed bust: his 18 rushing TDs in 2025 are seen as unsustainable, with Vegas team-total math projecting ~14 for 2026 (source: SI Onsi '2026 Fantasy Football All-Bust Team', Aug 2026).

Matthew Stafford is flagged as a bust/regression candidate by multiple outlets: his 46 TD passes in 2025 relied on inflated red-zone efficiency, with Vegas projecting ~29.5 for 2026 (sources: SI Onsi Bust Team and fantasysixpack Overvalued Players, Aug 2026).

Christian McCaffrey (30 years old, extensive injury history, league-leading touch total last year) is repeated as a top bust at his RB1-tier ADP (source: rotoballer 'Fantasy Football Busts: Overvalued Players To Avoid 2026', Aug 2026).
Davante Adams projected for ~40% touchdown regression off his 2025 total at his WR23-range ADP (source: rotoballer Overvalued Players, Aug 2026).

FantasyPros' quarterback strategy piece: don't draft a QB before round 8 at the earliest given depth of ~20 viable starters; Josh Allen (QB1, late-3rd ADP) vs. Brock Purdy (late-8th ADP) framing used to argue for a late-QB build (source: FantasyPros 'How to Draft Quarterbacks 2026', Aug 2026).

Tight end strategy: wait and take multiple shots on ascending-role/athletic TEs after the top-8; Tucker Kraft, Harold Fannin Jr., and Kyle Pitts Sr. named as prime post-top-tier targets (source: FantasyPros Draft Strategy Guide, Aug 2026).

2026 is described as having 'a dozen or so legitimate workhorse running backs,' making Zero-RB less appealing than in past years; Hero-RB (one stud RB early, hammer value elsewhere) is the more common recommendation for a pick-4 slot (sources: thepicks.com 'Is Zero RB Smart in 2026', and fantasysixpack RB Draft Strategies, Aug 2026).

Blake Corum is called 'the premier handcuff to target' after logging 145 carries for 746 yards/6 TDs in 2025 as Kyren Williams' backup (source: Yahoo Sports 'Top 6 RB handcuffs to target in 2026', Aug 2026).

Week 1 2026 streaming D/ST targets called out: LA Chargers (vs. ARI), Las Vegas Raiders (vs. MIA), and Tennessee Titans (vs. NYJ, low 38.5 implied total) (sources: draftsharks Streaming Defense Week 1 and rotowire Week 1 D/ST Picks, Sept 2026).

Top Week 1 kicker recommendations: Jason Myers (2025 kicker MVP), Brandon Aubrey (Cowboys, dome, high-scoring offense), Ka'imi Fairbairn; Harrison Mevis (LAR vs. injury-depleted SF defense) flagged as a sleeper stream (source: FantasyPros Kicker Rankings Week 1, Sept 4-5 2026).

RJ Harvey flagged as a bust: 7 of his TDs came in 3 combined games (high concentration/variance) and he's expected to cede carries back to a returning J.K. Dobbins (source: SI Onsi Bust Team, Aug 2026).
Dallas Goedert listed as a TE bust: his 11 TDs relied on scheme-specific looks unlikely to continue under a new offensive coordinator (source: SI Onsi Bust Team, Aug 2026).
